kernel: measurement/step.c (constant-instruction primitives: branch-free addmod, 6-limb comparisons, selection in the minimum; per-walk anchors; canonical DP exponents; 128-bit fingerprint from key bits 70..197; trail age; v9: each trail ends at its first distinguished point and at the trail cap; the walk restarts with the additive step at index h = mix((w + 1) GAMMA + t) mod RA; a restarted state that is itself a distinguished point is stored and restarted again, chained)
measurement_tool: organizer image via measurement/measure.sh (blst commit f7a88067, GCC 14.2.0, Valgrind 3.24.0 Callgrind Ir), walk runs N1=256/N2=512, MODE sizes 4096/8192 (mul, sqr, restartbench, storebench)
method: Per-step instruction counts of forced-type runs at the production header DP_BITS = 60 (no distinguished points): all-adder inputs (S=0), all-square inputs (S=1024). The per-step count is the difference of Callgrind totals between 256 and 512 rounds divided by 256 * 64 (analyze.py). The cost of one distinguished-point record is measured alone (mode storebench) and the restart alone (mode restartbench). An all-distinguished-point run (DP_BITS 0) is not measurable under the chained rule (every restarted state is a DP, so the chain never ends).

reference_unit.organizer_measurement_method: REF_FUNCS=ref_mul toggle pass, (ref-512 - ref-256) / (adds-512 - adds-256) at seed 1
reference_unit.charged: 1 unit (the organizer's reference operation; the adder calls it)

restart_instructions.measurement: mode restartbench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for restart_walk on walk 0 (counter, mix, table step, key_of, state clear)
restart_instructions.charged: one adder step (A_UNITS) per restart, per spec section 8

distinguished_point_record_instructions.measurement: mode storebench: (Ir(8192) - Ir(4096)) / 4096 for one record (fingerprint and two canonical exponents)

sort_compare_exchange_instructions.measurement: mode sortbench of step.c at 4096 (196632) and 8192 (393240) iterations, v9 kernel: one 128-bit comparison and one 80-byte exchange per iteration
sort_compare_exchange_instructions.role: kernel ring micro-benchmark (128-bit compare and 80-byte exchange in the ring); not charged; the table is charged at the sortnet values

production_walk_dp60.note: mixed walk at S=458, DP_BITS 60; the charges use the forced per-type counts

charged.RESTART_INST: A_INST: one restart is charged one full adder step; the measured restart (26537.0) is below it
charged.table: accounting.py build(): per record (DP_STORE_INST + RESTART_INST + SCATTER_INST 24 + TRANSFER_INST 100000 + OVERFLOW_INST 10); per slot of the 2^37 x 2^31 bucket table (bitonic compare-exchange 108.0030 and scan 13; sortnet/RESULT-sortnet.json and RESULT-sortnet64.json); one cursor reset per bucket
charged.restart_rule: v9 chained: at a distinguished point the walk stores its record and restarts with the additive step at index h = mix((w + 1) GAMMA + t) mod 1024, t the walk's restart counter (incremented before use), w its global index, kn the argmin index of the state; if the restarted state is itself a distinguished point it is recorded and restarted again, until it is not. Every restart (including chained ones) costs one A_UNITS (spec section 9.1). Cap restarts store no record and are charged the same restart.
charged.events: 66 * A_UNITS per detected cycle (walk-through of at most 64 steps, the check step and the escape), unchanged; the closure reserve of accounting.py is K p M events (K = 50)

replica.verification: v9 matrix (bin/matrix_cases, RESULT-v9.json): DP_BITS 60, 4, 3, 2 and trail-cap builds, 512 and 4096 rounds; all pass: True

native_counts: evidence/native-counts.json (uninstrumented, production DP_BITS = 60, v9 kernel, 2^20 rounds per seed)
deviations: v9 replaces the v8 fixed start-element restart with the counter rule (spec section 6, v9): a walk that returns to an earlier DP no longer repeats its earlier trail.

Chained restarts (spec section 6, v9): a restarted state that is itself a DP is recorded and restarted again; the all-DP forced run (DP_BITS 0) therefore never ends and is replaced by the storebench and restartbench costs.
At the production DP_BITS = 60 no restart occurs, so the walk counts equal the previous revision's (native adds, sqrs, cyc2, cycl identical to the v8 DP_BITS 60 run).
The constant-instruction change raises the adder step by about 800 instructions (about 0.04 units); the charge follows the measured counts.
Memory transfers are charged as the instructions of the moves (exchanges), not as separate storage costs.
The solve/verify/output charge (2^29 instructions) is an assumed bound; its share of W_MAX is 2^14.7 of 2^125.8 units.
